text:
marta: Hi — I just returned from medical leave and missed open enrollment. I also got married overseas on 2026-04-10 and my spouse has a child (stepchild) I'd like to add. Is there any flexibility to enroll now? The marriage certificate is delayed because it was processed at the registry office.
jason-p: congrats! :tada: Marriage is a QLE, but 30 days is the standard window. Tagging @noah-benefits to confirm exceptions for medical leave.
noah-benefits: Congrats! Short answer: marriage is a QLE and typically you have 30 days from the event to report it. However, we do make limited exceptions if you were medically incapacitated or on an approved medical leave that prevented you from accessing the portal.
marta: I was on FMLA and couldn't sign in; HR has my leave paperwork. Can that count as a valid reason? Also how do I add the stepchild — what docs are required?
noah-benefits: Yes — FMLA/medical leave documentation can support an exception. Please upload a copy of your approved leave authorization or medical certification along with proof of marriage. For adding a stepchild we need: 1) marriage certificate (or temporary proof of marriage) 2) stepchild proof of relationship — one of: birth certificate showing parent name, court guardianship/custody paperwork, or a signed notarized affidavit from the biological parent confirming dependent status. If any docs are not in English, a certified translation is fine.
peopleops-liz: Additional note: if the marriage occurred abroad and the certificate is pending, an embassy/consulate marriage record or a digital registry receipt is usually acceptable temporarily.
marta: Good. If we qualify for an exception, can coverage be effective retroactive to the marriage date or only from the approval date? Also what about dental/vision and dependent life?
noah-benefits: If we approve an exception, effective date options depend on timing: we can generally make coverage effective as of the marriage date (retro) if the request and supporting docs are received within a reasonable short window — we try to match the event date where allowed. Dental/vision/dependent life can also be added retroactively under the same QLE approval. Premiums will be reconciled retro in payroll.
payroll-bot: Payroll clarification: retroactive premium adjustments will be posted in the next 1-2 pay cycles after benefits processes the event. You may see a single net deduction or a credit depending on prior withholdings. If you'd prefer to spread the impact, payroll can split the adjustment across two cycles upon request (email payroll@redwood.example).
marta: What about HSA contributions? I have HSA and contribute pre-tax. Changing dependents midyear — any tax forms or pro-rations?
noah-benefits: Adding dependents doesn't generally change your HSA eligibility, but if you're switching medical plans (e.g., from HSA-eligible HDHP to non-HSA plan) that's a separate QLE choice. Contribution limits are annual; if we change plan type midyear we recommend coordinating with payroll — we can adjust pre-tax deductions and you'll receive an updated year-to-date contribution statement. No special tax form from us beyond the normal W-2 reporting at year-end.
jason-p: And dependent care FSA? My spouse wants DC-FSA now.
noah-benefits: Dependent Care FSA elections follow their own midyear rules — you can typically enroll on a QLE for dependents if eligible; contributions start the next payroll after enrollment and are prorated for the remainder of the plan year. Check the DC-FSA plan doc for limits.
marta: Where do I submit the docs to request the exception and add the stepchild?
noah-benefits: Steps: HR Portal > Benefits > Report a Life Event > Choose: "Add dependent  marriage/stepchild" > In the notes select: "Requesting exception due to medical leave; FMLA docs attached" > Attach: leave paperwork + marriage proof + stepchild documentation. If you prefer, open a case and cc benefits@redwood.example.
peopleops-liz: Example note to paste: "Requesting QLE exception. Marriage date: 2026-04-10. On approved medical leave (FMLA) from 2026-03-15 to 2026-04-25; attaching leave authorization. Request retroactive coverage to marriage date and add spouse + stepchild (docs attached)."
marta: Thanks — uploading files now. Appreciate the help.
noah-benefits: Case created: #BEN-81390. We'll review and aim to respond within 3-5 business days. If we need additional docs we'll ping you here.
jason-p: nice, congrats again :celebrate:
